tldr: Anthropic cut Claude prices by 40% for US government buyers under a new deal. OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra is now in ChatGPT and the API, with API prices 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra. Nous Research revamped its Hermes Agent plans, and every new plan includes a cloud agent. A Reddit user ran a DeepSeek model on a single graphics card at about 41 tokens per second.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs at 41 tokens/s on one RTX 3090
articles.summary: A Reddit user runs a Q2 build of DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 on one RTX 3090 at about 41 tokens/s, and says its output matches DeepSeek's API.

articles.title: Artificial Analysis releases Intelligence Index v5
articles.summary: Artificial Analysis calls v5 of its Intelligence Index a major upgrade. It widens the gap between open-weight and closed models. Some users doubt it.

articles.title: GPT-6.1 Terra rolls out in ChatGPT and the API
articles.summary: Paid ChatGPT plans and the API get GPT-6.1 Terra as gpt-6.1-terra. OpenAI says standard API prices are 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra.

articles.title: Anthropic expands US government deal: Claude at 40% off
articles.summary: Under a new OneGov agreement, Claude goes to federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments at 40% off.

articles.title: Hermes Agent plans revamped: every new plan includes a cloud agent
articles.summary: Usage now has daily and weekly limits instead of one monthly block of credits. Paid Nous Portal tiers add a Hermes Agent instance and computer.

articles.title: GPT-6.1 Terra now selectable in Hermes Agent
articles.summary: Hermes Agent users can pick GPT-6.1 Terra through Nous Portal or OpenRouter.

articles.title: Hermes Agent gets an Advanced Delegation modes plugin
articles.summary: The plugin lets the Hermes Agent orchestrator pick a different model or profile for each subagent, using routes the user sets up.

articles.title: Teknium: try Hermes Agent's 'main' release channel early
articles.summary: Teknium invites users to try the 'main' release channel early instead of 'stable'.

articles.title: Garry Tan: agents can run customer replies and CRM notes for founders
articles.summary: An agent drafts support replies, call recaps and cancellation notes, and manages the CRM and bug filing. The founder reads and sends.

articles.title: StreamVibe: proactive video agents for changing user intent
articles.summary: A research paper on video agents that adapt when a user's intent changes.

articles.title: On-Policy Self-Training: data-free self-improvement for LLMs
articles.summary: A research paper on LLMs that improve themselves without labelled data.

articles.title: Anthropic scientists start drug discovery work with six research partners
articles.summary: Anthropic has research partnerships with six organisations building new medicines, and has started its own drug discovery work.
